title: Integrate V2 client interactions
goal: Implement the approved V2 plan overview, manual assignment, two-stage ETA and cryostat confirmation, deliverable submission, manual acceptance, focus and error flows on top of integrated TASK-031 and TASK-033 contracts while preserving V1 views
acceptance_criteria: Implement all six V2 zones with human-only create assign submit and review flows
Use the frozen 34 API contracts including stale preview re-confirmation and stable errors
Preserve V1 five-view interactions, personal progress independence, focus restoration and error state retention
All syntax automated desktop browser and Release checks pass

release_controls.execution_window: after TASK-031 and TASK-033 are integrated and approved in the current V2 session
release_controls.rollback_plan: revert the independent app.js delivery commit; if a real database was migrated also use the WP-006 database rollback
release_controls.observation_metrics: syntax and test results, API and DOM contract coverage, key browser flows, V1 regressions, reviewer evidence
release_controls.stop_conditions: A or B contract drift, stale preview bypass, automatic task creation, V1 regression, failing validation, or unresolved reviewer finding
